added.candidate: Samsung/Nova SPIE MIPC XXXIX paper 'Challenges and responses of metrology technologies for the new wave of 3D NAND devices' (DOI 10.1117/12.3050400)
added.summary: Samsung-led paper: 2 of 3 authors are Samsung Flash PD Team, 1 is Nova. Full text is the author manuscript on novami.com; venue and DOI come from Crossref. It is about wafer-to-wafer hybrid Cu bonding in 3D NAND. SAM makes the void maps, but a full-wafer scan takes 10-20 min, so Samsung developed an interferometry map that takes under 1 min and correlates with the SAM map. Stated SAM limits: penetration depth and throughput. AFM gives sub-nm Cu recess but has 'low throughput' for HVM, and high-speed AFM is 'early stage'. Voids >100 um cause wafer breakage. Warpage is monitored at every step. Edge roll-off is measured by Nova broadband spectral interferometry. All [F]; table rows 1-4.

added.candidate: Samsung-led slide deck 'Production-Ready Hybrid Metrology for Deep 3D Structure Profiling Using SE and X-ray Diffraction' (cdn.fs.pathlms.com, dated 2026-03-18)
added.summary: 3 of 5 authors Samsung DS, plus one each from Onto and Rigaku. Optical SE loses resolution in deep VNAND (WL ~200-400), so X-ray diffraction CD (XCD / CD-SAXS) was adopted. Measurement time fell from 30 to ~5.7 min. Onto MGML raised correlation from 0.63 to 0.72. 'Production-Level' and 'production-ready' are tagged [C]. A remaining-challenges slide and future work to cut scan time are recorded. The venue (FCMN) is not printed in the deck. Table rows 5-6.

added.candidate: SK hynix co-authored ACS Omega 'Material-Mechanistic Interplay in SiCN Wafer Bonding for 3D Integration' (PMC12224090) and ACS AEM companion 10.1021/acsaelm.6c00446
added.summary: University-led: corresponding author at YNU; 3 of 8 authors SK hynix, 1 TEL Kyushu, 1 U Tsukuba.
